atoms.name: Closed form
atoms.one_line: $w=(X^\top X+\lambda I)^{-1}X^\top y$; one feature: $\sum xy/(\sum x^2+\lambda)$.

atoms.name: Shrinkage
atoms.one_line: $\lambda=0$ is OLS; $\lambda\to\infty$ gives $w\to0$; weights shrink but are not exactly zero.

atoms.name: Invertibility
atoms.one_line: $X^\top X+\lambda I$ is invertible for $\lambda>0$, fixing collinearity.

atoms.name: Intercept and scaling
atoms.one_line: Do not penalise the intercept; standardise features first.
